description: This file defines the 'Coocook::Model::Organizations' class, which manages organization-related data operations such as creation, lookup by name, and name availability checks within the Coocook application. It interacts with the database schema and handles transaction logic for creating organizations and associating users.

classes.name: Coocook::Model::Organizations
classes.description: A model class responsible for managing organization data, including creation, lookup, and name availability within the Coocook application.

methods.name: ACCEPT_CONTEXT
methods.description: Sets the schema attribute for the current context, retrieving the database schema from the Catalyst context.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new organization with specified attributes, ensuring the name is unique, and associates an owner user.

methods.name: find_by_name
methods.description: Finds an organization record by its name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: name_available
methods.description: Checks if a given name is available for use, not used by users or organizations, and not blacklisted.
